address: Canal Place, 32 Andrews Road, Dalston, London, E8 4FX, United Kingdom
bio: It may be located beneath a modern apartment block, but the quasi-industrial look and warm service give this bright and airy restaurant added personality. The appealing menu is supplemented by some blackboard specials, such as delicious pork and rabbit rillettes. The cooking is pleasingly understated, allowing the ingredients room to shine, while the chef-owner’s Irish heritage is evident in the excellent Guinness bread and subsequent Guinness bread ice cream, which has become something of a signature....
